summary: Mint Incorporation Limited, a BVI-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a corporate name change to Axonex AI Group Limited, effected September 28, 2026 upon issuance of the BVI registrar's certificate, with amended and restated memorandum and articles adopted by director resolution on September 8, 2026. Class A ordinary shares begin trading on Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker AXNX (formerly MIMI) at the open on October 13, 2026; the CUSIP is unchanged. No price, stake, premium or consideration terms are stated. Watch for any concurrent transactions accompanying the rebranding.
